statement: ∀ (q r : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), q ≤ r → KdVPlan.MemH r f → KdVPlan.HB q f (KdVPlan.hn r f)
proof:
intro q r f hqr hf
have hn : ∀ s k, 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 := by
  intro s k
  exact mul_nonneg (yui_aux_0001 T gamma R s k).1.le (sq_nonneg _)
have hle : ∀ k, KdVPlan.weight q k * ‖f k‖^2 ≤ KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖f k‖^2 := by
  intro k
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k : ℝ)]) hqr
have hq : KdVPlan.MemH q f := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (hn q) hle hf
refine ⟨hq, Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_⟩
exact hq.tsum_le_tsum hle hf
